decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a reliable, high-quality backpack for general use or hiking. The consideration set included a tactical pack (Explorer), a military-style rucksack (Fox Outdoor), a premium waterproof pack (USWE), a small sling bag (MOSISO), and a budget laptop bag (KAUKKO). However, the search results were heavily cluttered with unrelated camping items like astronaut food, water bottles, and tent stakes. Among the actual backpacks, the budget-friendly options (KAUKKO and Fox Outdoor) had concerning reviews regarding durability, specifically broken straps and poor buckle quality. The USWE pack was far beyond my expected price range at over $200. Because none of the options provided a good balance of quality, reliability, and value, I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
